name: banner
description: Inline status/severity banner — semantic variant (info/success/warning/error) × size (sm/md/lg). Consolidates the old alert. Optional leading icon, action slot (consumer-provided node), and stateless dismiss: pass onDismiss and a close button renders (composed from iconOnly Button at color=inherit); consumer owns visibility. Layout-agnostic — the consumer places it top-of-page, in-form, or inline. role=status (polite), overridable.
